post.title: Paperclip Agent Company Orchestrator
post.hook: If OpenClaw is an employee, this is the company: org charts, budgets, heartbeats.
post.summary: Paperclip is an open-source Node.js server and React UI that runs a team of AI agents like a company, with org charts, budgets, governance and tickets. The repo holds 1,474 commits from 66 authors over about six weeks.
post.writeup:
## What it is
Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. You bring your own agents (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Bash, HTTP), assign goals, and track work and cost from one dashboard. It looks like a task manager, but underneath it has org charts, budgets, governance and goal alignment.

## Why it exists
The README frames the pain directly: 20 Claude Code tabs open, lost context after a reboot, runaway token loops, and recurring jobs you have to remember to kick off. The pitch is to manage business goals, not pull requests.

## How it works
- Define a goal, hire a team, approve and run.
- Heartbeats wake agents on a schedule. If it can receive a heartbeat, it's hired.
- Task checkout and budget enforcement are atomic, so there is no double-work and no runaway spend.
- Tasks carry full goal ancestry, so agents see the "why".
- Every entity is company-scoped, so one deployment can run many isolated companies.
- Company templates can be exported and imported with secret scrubbing.

Adapters ship as separate packages (claude-local, codex-local, cursor-local, opencode-local, pi-local, openclaw-gateway). The stack is TypeScript (96.1%), Express, Drizzle, React, Vite and Vitest.

## Evals
An evals folder uses promptfoo to test heartbeat skill behavior, such as checking out before work, stopping on a 409 conflict, and refusing cross-company actions.

## Results
The git history shows 1,474 commits across 66 authors between 2026-02-16 and 2026-03-30, peaking at 402 commits in the week of 2026-03-02. Packages reached version 0.3.1.

## Open questions
Clipmart, a marketplace of one-click company templates, is still marked coming soon. The README is also noted as a draft-driven document, so product claims are worth checking against the running code.
